projects.name: AIOS
projects.reason: The repository's LICENSE file contains only a newline, so the public implementation has no effective usage grant.

projects.name: Claude Code
projects.reason: The public repository contains plugins, documentation, and installers rather than the core client implementation; its license reserves modification rights.
projects.reconsider_when: The core implementation is published under a qualifying license.

projects.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
projects.reason: The custom license permits running and limited redistribution but prohibits modification and derivative works.
projects.reconsider_when: The implementation is released under a qualifying license.

projects.name: Daytona
projects.reason: The current default branch contains a README and assets but not the sandbox implementation represented by the repository's historical stars.
projects.reconsider_when: A maintained public implementation returns to the default branch.

projects.name: Multica
projects.reason: The source-available license restricts hosted services and commercial embedding, so it is not treated as an open core entry.
projects.reconsider_when: The core implementation adopts an OSI-approved license.

projects.name: Vibe Kanban
projects.reason: The project README announces that Vibe Kanban is sunsetting.
projects.reconsider_when: Maintainers formally resume the project or identify a maintained successor.
